_note: Invocation strings below are VERIFIED against the CLIs installed on this box (2026-09-03), not the flags assumed in the v2 spec. See _corrections for what changed and why.
_unverified_note: factory (Factory.ai 'droid' CLI) is registered but NOT yet installed or authenticated on this box. Its invoke string is transcribed from https://docs.factory.ai/reference/cli-reference (Sept 2026), not verified. Before first use: install droid, export FACTORY_API_KEY (or run `droid` once to log in), then run `droid exec --help` and reconcile the flags here + agents/factory/run.sh, and move it out of _unverified.

_corrections.claude: --max-turns does not exist in this build; bounded with --max-budget-usd instead. -p takes prompt text (or stdin), never a file path.
_corrections.antigravity: No --headless / --input flags. Uses -p/--print with --output-format json. settings.json permissions are ignored in print mode, so --dangerously-skip-permissions is required and safety is enforced by agents/_lib/guard.sh instead.
_corrections.opencode: No --headless / --input flags. Uses 'run' subcommand with --format json and --auto for permissions.
_corrections.factory: UNVERIFIED (see _unverified_note). Headless mode is the `exec` subcommand: `droid exec -f <file> --output-format json --auto <low|medium|high> --cwd <path>`. `--auto` is tiered: read-only default, low = edit files, medium = install deps + build/test + LOCAL git commits, high = push/deploy. Worker roles need local commits, so medium; they still never push (guard.sh + the prompt forbid it). No --max-budget-usd equivalent — timeout is the only hard stop. No token accounting in the JSON envelope: {type,subtype,is_error,duration_ms,num_turns,result,session_id}. Auth: export FACTORY_API_KEY=fk-... in the runner's environment, or `droid` interactive login (writes ~/.factory/).
